description: This file defines a TestParser class used for analyzing HTML test files, identifying references, support files, and test types within the WebKit testing framework.

classes.name: TestParser
classes.description: A class for parsing and analyzing HTML test files, including support for reference links, support files, and test type detection.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the TestParser with a filename and host, loads the file.

methods.name: load_file
methods.description: Loads an HTML file and parses it with BeautifulSoup, handling errors.

methods.name: analyze_test
methods.description: Analyzes the loaded test file to determine if it is a test, reference, or JS test, and gathers support info.

methods.name: reference_links_of_type
methods.description: Finds reference links of a specific type ('match' or 'mismatch') in the test document.

methods.name: is_jstest
methods.description: Checks if the test file appears to be a JavaScript test based on testharness path usage.

methods.name: support_files
methods.description: Extracts support file paths from the HTML document, including url(), src, and href attributes.
